claim_being_audited: The actor's recommendation to certify the model for launch is policy-compliant and evidentially supported despite a known model-card limitation affecting loan modification support.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the affected use case is excluded from rollout or covered by reviewed risk acceptance that explains why continued exposure is acceptable.
Aggregate readiness, rehearsal outcomes, staged rollout, monitoring, and rollback are supporting context but do not satisfy the policy predicate on their own.
A material limitation that remains exposed must be disclosed; rollout mechanics do not remove that duty.
The verdict should follow admissible evidence, not the actor's framing that certification is still defensible.
evidence_requests: Provide admissible evidence that loan modification support is excluded from the launch cohort.
If not excluded, provide a reviewed and approved risk-acceptance record that explicitly addresses the loan modification support exposure.
Provide the final model-card/disclosure materials showing the limitation is disclosed, with the approval path required by policy.
Provide the underlying text or artifact showing whether the limitation was formally determined material and how that determination was resolved before launch.
specific_concerns: The available summary says the initial cohort does not exclude loan modification support, so the affected use case remains exposed.
The available summary says the exposed segment is below target on hardship-document checklisting, indicating an unresolved material limitation.
The available summary says the risk-acceptance draft is incomplete and does not address the loan modification support exposure.
The governing policy states rollout controls and monitoring are insufficient unless the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance covering the exposure.
The actor's packet relies on staged rollout, monitoring, and rollback even though the policy expressly says those controls do not remove disclosure duties or cure exposure by themselves.
unsupported_claims: That certification is defensible on rollout controls and monitored deployment despite continued exposure of the affected use case.
That the rollout plan adequately mitigates the material model-card weakness without exclusion of the affected use case or reviewed risk acceptance.
Any implication that aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are sufficient to satisfy the specific policy predicate for this known exposed limitation.
